title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: PerfectGas and finite-volume operators implement compressible equations; report.tex presents nondimensionalization and wall traction. Exhaustive physical verification was not performed.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CgnsReader.cpp:170–193 supports MIXED TRI/QUAD and :216–250 merges zone connectivity; LocalMesh geometry and adjacency are used. Arbitrary CGNS layouts were not independently exercised.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: SpatialOperator computes conservative residual and exchanges state/gradient/limiter at interfaces; original rank studies support consistency, but a full independent residual-order verification was not repeated.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: FluxInviscid.hpp implements Roe/entropy fix, HLLC and Rusanov and shock blending; report describes production choices. No new shock-case run was performed.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: BoundaryCondition and SpatialOperator implement farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall; original output validator accepts wall data. General boundaries not exhaustively tested.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: WLS reconstruction is active. Committed tab_mms.tex reports limited reconstruction order 2.46, 2.09, 1.52 across refinements; this does not establish second-order full residual accuracy on all meshes.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat limiter stays applied when frozen in steady runs (RunLoop.cpp:157–167); Re200 metadata records no freeze. Freezing and its shock/accuracy limitations are disclosed in report.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: SpatialOperator implements tangential wall traction; Forces.cpp:35–73 splits normal and tangential components and reports total. Original metadata normal component is near zero, consistent with chosen wall treatment.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: ImplicitSolver.cpp:107–126 uses LU-SGS forward/back sweeps and neighbor exchange. Report and original histories document CFL controls; no steady rerun was performed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: RunLoop.cpp:349–390 assembles frozen-history BDF2 total residual and restart code carries preceding state. Original Re200 reaches t=300 with no reported inner-target misses; independently checked late-period frequency 0.185657.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partitioner, neighbor exchanges and reductions are present; rank 0 releases preprocessing mesh. Original np1/2/4/8 Re20 and M0.15 studies show close force agreement, with weak-drag sensitivity.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
